'''Anti-gravity belts''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] devices which allowed individuals to simulate flight, rising many, many meters above the ground. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] used the devices on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] during their attack on [[Kharys]]. Coupled with winged disguises, the two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] resembled native [[S'kytri]], enabling them to surprise Kharys' [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. It's possible that this device may be similar or identical to the [[grav-belt]] used by [[Jediboh Opera]] performers.
